title: Killing Living Creatures
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 56.71 Linked Discourses 56.71
  • 8. Dutiyaāmakadhaññapeyyālavagga 8. Abbreviated Texts on Raw Grain

Pāṇātipātasutta Killing Living Creatures

… “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye pāṇātipātā appaṭiviratā. “… the sentient beings who refrain from killing living creatures are few, while those who don’t refrain are many. …” Taṁ kissa hetu? …pe….

Paṭhamaṁ.
